note: zornec ADJ wrathful — "cz" for "z" + adjective inflection, "got ein czorniger der do" = a wrathful god who there, all ADJ (biblical description of an angry God)
volgender ADJ following — present participle adjective, "Und noch volgende czogen ein" = And then following/next [they] marched, all ADJ pres.part. (Numbers march narrative)
vluz NOM flow/flux — genitive form "vluzzes", "von dem vlusse ires blutes" = from the flow of their blood, all NOM genitive (Leviticus impurity/blood flow laws)
vogel NOM bird — dative plural "-n" ending, "wol von vogiln als von" = well from birds as from, all NOM dative plural (Leviticus clean/unclean birds)
vride NOM peace — genitive form "vrides", "geczelt des friedes Und alles" = tent of peace And all, all NOM genitive (Numbers peace offering context)
sëhste NUM sixth — ordinal adjective, "Und einen sechster oles Und" = And a sixth of oil And, all NUM ordinal (Leviticus/Numbers offering measurements)
spîse NOM food/dish — plural/dative, "seinen opfer speisen Das ist" = his offering foods That is, all NOM (Leviticus grain offering context)
mittentac NOM midday/south — genitive form, "teile des mittages gegen czudin" = part of the south/midday toward ..., all NOM genitive (tabernacle orientation; same as mittagis batch34)
tôt ADJ/NOM dead — "t" ending variant of "toten", "vnd ir totis sult ir" = and your dead shall you, all ADJ/NOM (Leviticus/Numbers handling the dead)
thymian NOM thyme-incense — adjective form, "enczunden das thimiamisch puluer aus" = kindled the incense powder from, all ADJ (same as thimiamischen batch35; Exodus incense altar)
zwivalt ADJ twofold/double — "cz" for "z" without dative inflection, "gebe das czwiualdig wider Ist" = give that double back Is, all ADJ (Genesis double restitution law)
gesleht NOM lineage/tribe — semicolon artifact in tokenization, "noch seinem geslechte; vich vnd" = according to his lineage cattle and, all NOM (Leviticus livestock by kind)
verbrennen VRB to burn/scald — "vor" for "ver" prefix, "purge vnd vorbruen als das" = purify and burn as the, all VRB (Exodus/Leviticus purification by fire)
vüeren VRB to lead/carry — past participle ge+furen, "zu mag gefuren vnd ir" = can carry/lead and their, all VRB past part. (Numbers carrying the ark/tabernacle)
ûzvart NOM exodus/departure — "ou" for "û" Bavarian diphthong, "buch der ousvart von das" = book of the exodus/departure from the, all NOM (Exodus = Book of Going-Out; book title reference)

ûzlendisch ADJ foreigner/alien — "ou" for "û" + adjective ending, "Ein yclicher ouslendiger isset nicht" = Every foreigner shall not eat, all ADJ (Leviticus restrictions on foreigners; cf. NHG "Ausländer")
widersagunge NOM waters of strife — "wasser der widersagunge do krigten" = waters of strife where [they] fought, all NOM (Numbers 20 waters of Meribah/Kadesh)
abgot NOM idol/false god — "abt" for "ab" WZB variant, plural, "euch kein abtgote noch kein" = you no idols nor any, all NOM plural (Leviticus prohibition of idolatry)
endelist NOM outermost/edge — "ouf das endliste teil der" = on the outermost part of the, all NOM (Exodus/Numbers tabernacle edge measurements)
endelist NOM outermost/edge — plural/dative form, "an den endlisten drumern des" = on the outermost drums/boards of the, all NOM (tabernacle construction; same lemma as endliste)
korp NOM basket/container — "in einen korp vnd opfer" = in a basket and offer, all NOM (Leviticus/Deuteronomy first-fruits basket context)
setim NOM shittim/acacia — adjective form of setim (acacia wood), "machen von sethimischen holcze vnd" = make from shittim/acacia wood and, all ADJ (Exodus tabernacle construction; setim = acacia)
besæjen VRB to sow — imperative/subjunctive 2sg, "Sechs iar besee deinen acker" = Six years sow your field, all VRB (Exodus 23 sabbatical year law)
vîrelich ADJ festive/solemn — "ei" for "î" diphthong, "sein gar veierlich vnd heilig" = be very festive/solemn and holy, all ADJ (Leviticus sacred feast days; vîrelich = feast-like/solemn)
benennen VRB to name/call — past participle ge+benennen without ge-, "einer gerechticheit benvmet Und her" = named/called a righteousness And he, all VRB past part. (Deuteronomy legal naming context)
vünfzigeste NUM fiftieth — "cz" for "z", ordinal dative, "zu dem funfczigsten iare aller" = on the fiftieth year of all, all NUM ordinal (Leviticus 25 jubilee year)
vünfzigeste NUM fiftieth — "cz" for "z", ordinal nom./acc., "soltu das funfczigste iare vnd" = shall you the fiftieth year and, all NUM ordinal (Leviticus 25 jubilee proclamation)
vürhanc NOM curtain/veil — dative form, "gegen dem vorhange der do" = against/before the curtain that there, all NOM (Exodus tabernacle veil/curtain)
vürhanc NOM curtain/veil — "fur" for "vür" + "k" for "c", "ouch einen furhank von seideinen" = also a curtain of silken, all NOM (Exodus tabernacle entrance curtain; fürhanc variant)

gehenge NOM hanging/curtain — "vm" for "um" Bavarian, surrounding curtains of tabernacle, "enden der vmbhenge das man" = ends of the surrounding hangings that one, all NOM (Exodus tabernacle surrounding curtains; umgehenge noun form)
gehenge NOM hanging/curtain — "vmb" for "um" + "henge" = hangings, 5 occurrences alongside vmhenge (16), all NOM (tabernacle surrounding curtains variant form)
vorhof NOM forecourt/vestibule — "vnd ire vorheusern" = and their forecourts, MHG vorhûs/vorhof = vestibule/forecourt, all NOM plural (Numbers Levitical cities with forecourts)

Cêdar NAM cedar — adjective form meaning "of cedar/cedarwood", "sint vnd cedrein holcz vnd" = are and cedar wood and, all ADJ (Numbers/Deuteronomy cedar wood; closest available lemma for cedar material)

unmenschlich ADJ inhuman — nominalized form (NOM of adj), "ist ein vnmenschlichkeit Mit allem" = is an inhumanity With all, all NOM (Genesis/Deuteronomy moral condemnation; unmenschlichkeit = NOM of unmenschlich)
